name: write-goal
description: Provider-neutral goal writing with observable proof and optional application adapters.

interface.shortDescription: A finish line you can prove
interface.longDescription: Write one measurable completion condition with observable proof, preserved constraints, and a stopping boundary. The shared instructions are AI-agnostic; optional adapters provide Claude Code syntax or Codex goal-tool behavior. Plain text remains the default for other applications.
defaultPrompt: Draft a measurable completion condition for my task.
Refine this goal without changing its constraints.
